messages:
Alex: Heads-up: trying to run the ruby sampleapp on a fresh machine and auth keeps 401-ing during streaming tests. Anyone seen weird ENV token whitespace trimming issues?
Maria: uh oh. which quickstart? docker or local gem?
Alex: local gem. steps: rbenv 3.2.2, bundle install, export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(cat ~/token.txt) (token file had trailing newline). Example error: '401 Unauthorized - invalid_api_key' after first chunk then reconnects and fails.
Jonathan: sounds like our client might be chomp-ing token differently? ruby net/http vs httpx header folding? can you paste the header in logs (redact token)?
Alex: log shows 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>\\n' — there's a literal newline in the header value.
Maria: yikes. how is that getting through? shell substitution should strip? maybe token file has CRLF? show `od -c` or `xxd` output to confirm.
Alex: `od -c ~/token.txt` -> "61 62 63 \\n" so yes trailing \\n. i expected `$(cat file)` to include newline. we usually do `$(cat file | tr -d '\\n')` in guides.
Sam: We should update sampleapp README to recommend `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(tr -d '\\n' < token.txt)` or use an env-file. Low friction fix.
ci-bot: Note: opened devex PR #1421 to add trimming and a small test to Sam's sampleapp. CI shows flake on windows paths.
Jonathan: Also SDK parity note: Ruby client should call `.strip` on env fallback path to avoid this class of error. But be careful not to strip valid leading/trailing spaces user intentionally included? probably safe for tokens.
Maria: Agree strip in client is fine. We had earlier parity mismatch: go client does trimming in env fallback and retries differently for streaming. Add unit to ensure streaming auth header doesn't include newline.
Alex: PR link? can you drop it here
ci-bot: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/pull/1421
Sam: :thumbsup: I'll review and add a small docs blurb for onboarding.
Jonathan: If we change client behavior, add a CHANGELOG note and minor semver bump. Also add automated lint in sampleapp CI to catch newline tokens.
Alex: thanks all — workaround for now is `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(cat token.txt | tr -d '\\n')`. Will wait for the PR.
Maria: Filed a tiny followup issue to check windows CRLF vs mac/linux handling.
Sam: I'll put a tiny snippet in quickstart: `REDWOOD_API_KEY=$(printf '%s' "$(cat token.txt)")` and then `ruby sampleapp.rb` to avoid stray newline.
Alex: closing loop: retested after local patch strip in ENV code — streaming auth works. will merge once CI green.
Jonathan: Merged and released v1.4.1 with fix. :tada:
